values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/basslakemqt ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground', 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Drinking water from a hand-pump well. Carry-in, carry-out: no trash barrels (dumpsters at the Gwinn Field Office). Gravel boat launch, and a grassy picnic area with two tables by the water.

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/basslakemqt ('There are vault toilets', 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/basslakemqt ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis', 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 22 heavily shaded sites 'for tents and RVs' on one loop, some with direct water access. No length limit posted. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/basslakemqt ('this rustic campground offers 22 campsites for tents and RVs. The campground features a loop of heavily shaded sites, some of which offer direct water access', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Open all year, but the campground and seasonal roads are not plowed.

season.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/basslakemqt ('This rustic campground is open all year; however, the campground and seasonal roads are not plowed'), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic campground on a single shaded loop on the east shore of Bass Lake, 10 mi west of Gwinn via M-35 North, Horseshoe Lake Road and West Crooked Lake Lane. --Claude
summary: DNR page: 22 sites for tents and RVs, $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, carry-in/carry-out, gravel boat launch, first-come only, 15-day max (confirmed); added open all year (not plowed). The fees' old provenance cited the amenity table's Bass Lake row, which is a different campground (Luce County, 18 sites, managed by Tahquamenon Falls SP) - this Marquette County Bass Lake is not in the table; the fee now rests on its own page. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
